lane: Corroboration-count multi-line fusion: 4 fold-safe spy-PU experts (identical channel groups and PU protocol to FSML-PU preregistration) + 2 label-free lines (multiscale geopotential worm edges; strike-integrated scarp line evidence from src/gemsdoe33/r3_line_localized.py). GEO tip-lobe line dropped: its preregistered canary AUC was 0.501-0.505 (no signal).
hypothesis: Ranking by the NUMBER of independent physics lines simultaneously in their top decile (rather than a supervised blend dominated by single-head extremes) selects multi-physics-coincident lineaments, is surface-distinct from prior supervised blends, and recovers more withheld fault pixels than in-run A33-R2-CSHT at matched dotted emission.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contacts and buried pediment edges where gravity, magnetic, radiometric and topographic edges coincide without a throughgoing Quaternary fault; Lake Lahontan shoreline complexes.

new_label_free_line.worm: For fields {rtp, ext_TMI_up150, iso_grav_anom} and Gaussian scales sigma {1,2,4} px: grad_mag(field, sigma) * nms_ridge(grad_mag); worm_raw = mean over 9 combinations of within-footprint percentile ranks. Deterministic, catalogue-free, computed once.
new_label_free_line.l_line: Reused unchanged from A33-R3 (llc.build_line_evidence): within-regime rank of 12-azimuth strike-integrated Hessian ridge strength of LiDAR scarp evidence (100 m slope in voids). Label-free.

fusion.V1_cc6: C90 + 0.1 * mean(rank) over 6 lines, C90 = count of lines with rank >= 0.90
fusion.V2_cc4: C90 + 0.1 * mean(rank) over the 4 PU lines only (ablation isolating label-free lines)
